title: Primate Phylogeny
goal: A practitioner can visually assess the Primate Phylogeny scenario using its published diagram convention.

rubric.must: A rooted branching tree visibly shows the stated sister taxa and their clade relationships.
Horizontal branch lengths visibly vary to encode the supplied evolutionary distances.
The named taxa are legible at the tree tips.
The named clade is visibly highlighted distinctly from the rest of the tree.
A visible scale or distance label identifies the evolutionary-distance interpretation.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: Image 1 clearly shows the sister taxa and highlighted Homininae clade with varying branch lengths and an evolutionary-distance scale, whereas Image 2 lacks distance encoding and clade highlighting.
